Pilot · United Kingdom

Alastair Atchison

British Airways Flight 53901990
Flight
British Airways Flight 5390
Date
10 June 1990
Aircraft
BAC One-Eleven
Location
Southampton
Survivors
87 of 87 aboard

With the captain pinned half outside the broken windscreen, the first officer flew the BAC One-Eleven alone to an emergency landing at Southampton. Everyone survived.

Who helped

  • Nigel Ogden StewardRushed into the cockpit and grabbed Captain Lancaster as he was pulled out of the window, holding on to him until his own strength gave out.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • John Heward Chief steward (purser)Cleared the broken cockpit door from the controls and helped hold Captain Lancaster, taking over when Nigel Ogden tired.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Simon Rogers StewardStrapped himself into a cockpit seat and held Captain Lancaster by the ankles, relieving the exhausted Nigel Ogden until landing.Sources: 1 2 3 4

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_Airways_Flight_5390 ↗
